name: Kimi wa Pet.
source:
I'm just an ordinary girl you could find anywhere. (Well, that's what I think!)

I have no real idea what goes in the life-or-death fights between those on the outskirts of Namimori. I'm just a worker living an ordinary, but peaceful life.

However, one day, I somehow started looking after a bunch of maybe-animal babies! They're tough to deal with, so I'm constantly having a hard time.

On top of that, they're asking me to "return them to their previous forms!"

Just what is it do they think I can do?

My peaceful days are going to totally change... (By force)

[Translation of [URL=http://www.stellaworth.co.jp/shop/item.php?item_id=cPYqdqYcIYc]Stellworth's product information[/URL].]
translation:
我只是随处可见的普通女孩。（嗯，我是这么想的！）

我完全不了解并盛外围那些人之间的生死搏斗。我只是一个过着平凡但平静生活的上班族。

然而，某天我莫名其妙地开始照顾一群可能是动物的幼崽！它们很难对付，让我一直很头疼。

更过分的是，它们还要求我“把它们变回原来的样子”！

它们觉得我能做什么？

我平静的日子将彻底改变……（被迫的）

[翻译自[URL=http://www.stellaworth.co.jp/shop/item.php?item_id=cPYqdqYcIYc]Stellworth的产品信息[/URL]。]
